title: What If Earth Spun the Other Way?

scenes.text: What if Earth spun backwards? The first thing you'd notice is where the Sun comes up.
The Sun would rise in the west and set in the east. Venus already works this way.
The Coriolis effect would flip. Equatorial trade winds would stop blowing westward, and the mid-latitude winds that blow eastward would reverse.
Ocean currents would shift too, changing how warm and cold water move around the planet.
One 2018 climate model says the Sahara would not exist, while the southern US and eastern China would turn to desert.
And the Saharan dust that feeds the Amazon would stop crossing the Atlantic. Reverse the spin, and you rebuild the world's weather.

description:
